tests.test: T1 mid-day listing: first assessable = listing day + 31
T2 exactly 29 full prior days -> not assessable; 30 -> assessable
T3 calendar gap: days whose window contains the gap are not assessable
T4 delisting cut at 08:00 -> that day partial (480 listed minutes)
T5 destructive leakage: day d metrics unchanged when d and all later days are overwritten
T6 metrics equal direct computation over calendar days d-30..d-1
